title: DDN icon pack (ddn-icon-pack@1)
description: Normative schema for a DDN icon pack: a single self-contained JSON document pairing a manifest (identity, license, attribution, source) with a set of inline stroke-SVG icons. See standard/specification/49-icon-packs.md for the prose specification, including the sanitization requirements every consumer must enforce.

id.description: Pack namespace: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, an @-separator and a numeric major version. Icons are referenced as <pack-id>/<icon-id>.

version.description: Semantic version of the pack document. Icon removals or renames require a new pack major version (a new @N id), never an in-place edit.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the icon artwork license (for example MIT or GPL-2.0-or-later).

attribution.description: Copyright holder and project credit as it must appear in derivative notices.

source.description: Canonical upstream location of the artwork (URL or repository path).

licenseText.description: Full license text. Required whenever the license demands redistribution of the text (for example MIT); optional otherwise.

note.description: Free-form scope note: curation stance, disclaimers, omissions.

size.description: Edge of the square icon grid; every icon's viewBox must be '0 0 <size> <size>'.

strokeWidth.description: Nominal stroke width shared by the pack's icons, in grid units.

id.description: Icon identifier, unique within the pack.

svg.description: Complete inline SVG document, stroke-based, self-contained (no external references, scripts, event handlers or foreignObject — consumers reject it otherwise). At most 20 KiB.

kinds.description: DDN element kinds this icon binds to by default; omit or leave empty for override-only icons.

tags.description: Free-form classification for search and curation.
